customManagers.description: Version pins held in a Dockerfile ARG, annotated with a `# renovate:` comment on the line above.
The pinned Coolify version quoted in the README, kept in step with coolify/Dockerfile.

packageRules.description: Coolify minor and patch releases merge on their own once CI passes. The release must be at least 1 day old: upstream has shipped patch releases that broke self-hosted startup and fixed them within the hour.
Major Coolify releases change the compose topology this image replicates and need a human.
